title: Senior Software Engineer
must_have: 6+ years of experience in software engineering
text:
Senior Software Engineer
Nilgiri Technologies | Full-time | Hybrid, India

ABOUT THE ROLE
We are hiring a senior software engineer to join our software engineering team. You will work with cross-functional partners and own outcomes end to end.

MUST-HAVE REQUIREMENTS:
- AWS
- Docker
- Microservices
- Python
- Java
- 6+ years of experience in software engineering

NICE-TO-HAVE:
- Redis
- Kafka
- Kubernetes
- REST APIs

WHAT YOU WILL DO
- Drive payment reconciliation automation with measurable outcomes.
- Drive inventory synchronisation rollout with measurable outcomes.
- Drive order-management backend modernisation with measurable outcomes.
